newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SEA buys 80 pct stake in Conrad hotel.
newsitem.headline: SEA buys 80 pct stake in Conrad hotel.

text.p: SEA Holdings Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to buy an 80 percent stake in the Concord International Hong Kong hotel from third party Conrad International Investment Corp (CIIC) for HK$1.85 billion.
Conrad International Hong Kong is a 531-room hotel in the Pacific Place complex in Hong Kong's Admiralty district with a total gross floor area of 552,750 sq ft, it said in a statement.
SEA said its 60 percent owned unit Grandplus International Ltd agreed to buy 80 percent of Greenroll Ltd, which owns and operates the hotel, from CIIC.
The remaining 20 percent stake of Greenroll was held by a unit of Swire Pacific Ltd.
SEA said the purchase would be funded by bank borrowings and shareholders loans.
Greenroll posted pre-tax profit of HK$32.2 million in calendar 1994 and HK$53.2 million in 1995, the statement said.
SEA chairman Lu Ho said the purchase would present an opportunity for the company to expand its property portfolio in Hong Kong.
"SEA has no present plans to acquire interests in other hotels," Lu said.
